final: WITH patient_averages AS (SELECT ID, AVG(HGB) AS avg_hgb FROM Laboratory GROUP BY ID), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_hgb) AS overall_avg FROM patient_averages), kept AS (SELECT p.ID, p.avg_hgb, p.avg_hgb - o.overall_avg AS above_overall FROM patient_averages AS p CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE p.avg_hgb > o.overall_avg) SELECT ID, avg_hgb, above_overall, avg_hgb - (SELECT AVG(avg_hgb) FROM kept) AS above_kept_mean FROM kept ORDER BY above_kept_mean DESC LIMIT 10
